resources.name: Standard thermodynamic database (JANAF or equivalent)

access.notes: Requires standard Gibbs free energies of formation for Al₂O₃(s), SiO₂(s), 3Al₂O₃·2SiO₂(s) (mullite), SiO(g), O₂(g), SiO₂(g), Ta(s), and Ta₂O₅(s) at 1650, 1700, 1750, and 1800°C. Equivalent public compilations (e.g., FactSage, Kubaschewski tables) may be used.

resources.notes: The agent must obtain ΔfG° values for the listed species at the temperatures of interest from a recognized scientific compilation.
